sloka: जाम्बवन्तं गवाक्षं च स दृष्ट्वा शरपीडितौ।जग्राह परिघं घोरमङ्गदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।। ६.९९.१२ ।।
transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ gavākṣaṁ ca sa dṛṣṭvā śarapīḍitau।jagrāha parighaṁ ghoramaṅgadaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.99.12 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Gavaksha and Jambavantha afflicted by shafts, deluded with anger, Angada took hold of a dreadful iron bar.
